title_candidates: Microsoft launches seven MAI models you can compare in one playground
summary: Microsoft introduced seven in-house MAI models spanning reasoning, code, images, voice, and transcription, alongside a public playground for trying available models.

primary_source.title: Building a hill-climbing machine: Launching seven new MAI models
primary_source.author: Mustafa Suleyman
key_facts: Microsoft announced seven new in-house MAI models.
The family covers reasoning, code, images, transcription, and voice.
Microsoft provides a public MAI Playground for available models.

prerequisites: A Microsoft account may be required to generate results

steps.instruction: Compare the same bounded task across available MAI Playground models.
